$comment: Forbidden claims and their scope. A match fails `node scripts/verify-claims.mjs`. Add `claims-ok: <reason>` on the same line to opt out; every opt-out is printed by the gate so the exemption is never silent.

rules.reason: Rooms are encrypted in transit only — the Worker mints the room secret, so it could derive the key. E2E becomes claimable only when the Circle work (M3/M4) proves zero-knowledge.

rules.pattern: nothing is (ever )?stored(?! (after|once|when|until|in a|on a server after))|nothing is (ever )?kept(?! (after|once|when|until|in a))
rules.reason: Temporary Spaces hold items for a chosen duration, and the server keeps room state, IPs, sizes and times. An absolute is false; say what is actually true.
The service sees IP addresses, times and sizes. Aggregate counters are anonymous; the product is not.
True only until free-tier limits are reached; the product degrades rather than dying.
There are per-item and per-space caps; 'unlimited' is a promise the server breaks.
Counts come from the metrics service, never from copy. A hard-coded number is an invented one.
Space file storage is disabled (R2 binding commented out). Text and links only until it ships.
